WITH actor_years AS (
  SELECT 
    p.PID,
    m.year AS film_year
  FROM M_Cast mc
  JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
  JOIN Person p ON mc.PID = p.PID
  WHERE p.Gender = 'Male'
),
actor_year_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    PID,
    MIN(film_year) AS first_year,
    MAX(film_year) AS last_year,
    COUNT(*) AS num_film_years
  FROM actor_years
  GROUP BY PID
),
actor_gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    a.pid,
    a.first_year,
    a.last_year,
    a.num_film_years,
    (a.last_year - a.first_year) AS career_span
  FROM actor_year_stats a
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS actor_count
FROM actor_gaps
WHERE career_span - num_film_years <= 3
